title: PMS type approval roadmap
disclaimer: Sertifika/onay iddiası değildir. This roadmap is a plan; no class society has reviewed, assessed or awarded anything to POSEIDON.
sources: 03.01/NOZZLE Kaynakları/row:18-19 (competitor public material, not a requirement authority)

targetClass.selectionRule: Pilot customer's class first, then commercial priority (22.01 paragraph:50). Decided by Product Council (CA-01).

approvalScheme.note: The applicable scheme, its edition and its requirement matrix are read from the selected society's own published documents during CA-02 by a Class/Technical SME. Nothing here restates scheme requirements.

stages.name: Award
stages.claimRule: Sales and product material make no approval statement before a formal award (22.01 paragraph:78).

gaps.area: Equipment hierarchy and unique equipment identity
gaps.remaining: Scheme-specific identity/hierarchy criteria after CA-02; QA verification record.

gaps.area: Planned/unplanned maintenance lifecycle and recurring maintenance
gaps.remaining: Unplanned-maintenance path mapping and scheme criteria.

gaps.area: Running hours / measurement-point integrity and traceable source
Work-order postpone/approve controls with reason and audit trail
gaps.remaining: Postponement maximum-extension policy is UNCONFIGURED until a Technical SME sets it.

gaps.area: Critical equipment and critical task handling
gaps.remaining: Approved criticality catalogue does not exist; it is an expert decision, never seeded.

gaps.area: Job plan / revision history and fleet-standard job pool
gaps.remaining: Fleet-standard job pool is not implemented.

gaps.area: Completion evidence, verifier and immutable maintenance history
gaps.remaining: Independent QA verification and evidence pack.

gaps.area: Defect / safeguard / restriction link to equipment and readiness
Backup/restore, user authorization, audit trail and controlled software change
gaps.remaining: Measured restore rehearsal and signed rollback procedure (DEV-071) are DEFERRED.
Controlled regression evidence bound to a release commit.
